  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Swerve
    Manages a 4-module swerve drivetrain: hardware/simulation setup, acceleration- and speed-limited driving via Swerve.drive(frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveSpeeds), odometry feeding, and module/gyro access.
    SwerveController
    The recommended front door for driving the swerve: layers rotation-to-angle PID (SwerveController.lookAt(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d)), point-to-point translation PID (SwerveController.pidTo(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d)), and a named-channel gate (SwerveController.setControl(frc.lib.NinjasLib.swerve.SwerveSpeeds, java.lang.String)/SwerveController.setChannel(java.lang.String)) on top of the raw Swerve drivetrain, so only whichever command currently "owns" the requested channel can actually move the robot.
    SwerveSpeeds
    A ChassisSpeeds that additionally remembers whether it is field-relative or robot-relative, so speeds can be passed around and converted between the two frames without the caller needing to track that separately.
    SwerveSpeeds.SwerveSpeedsStruct
    WPILib Struct implementation that lets SwerveSpeeds be logged/sent as a raw struct type.
    SwerveUtils
    Stateless math helpers for swerve module optimization and acceleration-limited velocity stepping.
